parks.name: Apostle Islands National Lakeshore
parks.blurb: Islands and sea caves in Lake Superior; black bears, bald eagles, loons and foxes.

parks.name: Horicon National Wildlife Refuge
parks.blurb: Giant cattail marsh; Canada geese, sandhill cranes, pelicans and herons.

parks.name: Necedah National Wildlife Refuge
parks.blurb: Wetlands and savanna; whooping cranes, sandhill cranes, trumpeter swans and wolves.

parks.name: Kettle Moraine State Forest, Southern Unit
parks.blurb: Glacial hills and lakes; sandhill cranes, deer, wild turkeys and frogs.

parks.name: Devil's Lake State Park
parks.blurb: Quartzite bluffs around a lake; peregrine falcons, deer, turkeys and chipmunks.

parks.name: Peninsula State Park
parks.blurb: Door County cliffs and forest; bald eagles, deer, loons and red foxes.

parks.name: Crex Meadows Wildlife Area
parks.blurb: Sedge marsh and prairie; sandhill cranes, trumpeter swans, wolves and elk.

parks.name: Trempealeau National Wildlife Refuge
parks.blurb: Mississippi River backwater; trumpeter swans, bald eagles, ducks and turtles.

parks.name: Schlitz Audubon Nature Center
parks.blurb: Lakeshore woods near Milwaukee; owls, deer, turtles and woodpeckers.

parks.name: Wyalusing State Park
parks.blurb: River bluffs at Mississippi confluence; bald eagles, peregrine falcons, deer and turkeys.

parks.name: Governor Dodge State Park
parks.blurb: Driftless sandstone bluffs and lakes; deer, wild turkeys, bluebirds and herons.
